text: In less than a year, the world's first jet airliner broke up in the air three times. The de Havilland Comet flew higher, faster and quieter than any airliner before it. Then, in nineteen fifty-four, one came apart over the sea near Elba. The fleet was grounded, checked, and cleared to fly again. Two weeks later, another broke up near Naples. So engineers put a whole fuselage in a tank of water, and pumped it up and down, flight after flight, until it split open at a corner. What they found is why your plane window is round.
